summary: Saint Lucia's CIU publishes unusually detailed annual reports (FY2015/16-FY2024/25, audited statements) with applications received/granted/denied, NEF donations, bond inflows and remittances; all ten are stored. IMF Article IV tables (2017-2025 vintages) carry a narrow 'CIP' revenue line (transfers to central government, 0.5-1.3% of GDP) that is far smaller than what the CIU reports remitting, and was heavily revised for FY2019. Program terms are taken directly from the regulations (2015-2026).

events.title: Citizenship by Investment Act passed
events.description: Senate passes the Citizenship by Investment Act No. 14 of 2015.
events.quote: Passed in the Senate this 4th day of August, 2015.

events.title: Programme opens for applications
events.description: The CIU began receiving citizenship applications on 1 January 2016.
events.quote: since it commenced receipt of citizenship applications on January 1st, 2016.

events.title: NEF minimum halved to US$100,000
events.description: Amendment regulations cut the minimum NEF donation from US$200,000 to US$100,000, removed the 500-application cap and the US$3m net-worth affidavit, and let the Board keep 20% of NEF donations for marketing.
events.quote: lowering the minimum donation to the National Economic Fund from US $200,000 to US $100,000

events.title: 10% agent commission introduced
events.description: Promoters/agents receive a 10% commission on NEF investments; licensed promoters rose from 5 to 33.
events.quote: from July 1, 2017 we joined the rest of our regional counterparts by introducing an incentive plan

events.title: National Economic Fund Act
events.description: Saint Lucia National Economic Fund Act No. 18 of 2019 assented; NEF board to manage CIP donations (previously remitted to the Consolidated Fund).

events.title: COVID-19 relief bond option
events.description: Temporary US$250,000 non-interest bearing government bond route to raise funds during the pandemic; later extended to end-2021 and end-2022.
events.quote: (a) be made by the 31st day of December, 2020;

events.title: CIU told to remit excess cash to government
events.description: Memo from the Office of the Prime Minister instructs the CIU to remit excess cash to the Consolidated Fund.
events.quote: By way of memo dated November 23, 2020 from the Office of the Prime Minister the Unit is instructed to remit excess cash to the Consolidated Fund

events.title: Real estate cut to US$200,000; National Action Bond
events.description: Real estate minimum lowered from US$300,000 to US$200,000; National Action Bond (US$300,000) replaces COVID and regular bonds.
events.quote: These Regulations shall come into force on the 1st day of January, 2023.

events.title: Infrastructure (enterprise Option 3) route
events.description: New US$100,000 enterprise Option 3 for housing, social development and investment services projects, which the government calls an infrastructure option financed by developers recovering costs through CIP.
events.quote: in December 2023, this government introduced an infrastructure option to complement the other funding options.

events.title: Saint Lucia initially stays out of regional MOA
events.description: Budget address: Saint Lucia agreed with the regional CBI Memorandum of Agreement except the immediate rise in minimum investment, citing existing infrastructure contracts; its request for a grandfather clause was refused.
events.quote: We agreed with every provision of the MOA except for the immediate increase of the minimum investment level.

events.title: Minimums raised to US$240,000 (NEF)/US$300,000 (real estate)
events.description: Saint Lucia implements higher minimums in line with the regional agreement: NEF US$240,000, real estate US$300,000, enterprise Option 3 US$250,000.
events.quote: These Regulations are deemed to have come into force on the 1 day of July, 2024.

events.title: Marketing partners told to stop promoting visa-free access
events.description: CEO reports that during FY2024/25 the CIU instructed marketing partners to stop advertising visa-free access. Exact date not given.
events.quote: The Unit instructed all marketing partners to discontinue the promotion of visa free access

events.title: Not included in US partial visa restrictions
events.description: The US proclamation of 16 Dec 2025 imposed partial restrictions on Antigua and Barbuda and Dominica, citing CBI; Saint Lucia is not on the list.
events.quote: Angola, Antigua and Barbuda, Benin, Burundi, Cote d 'Ivoire, Cuba, Dominica, Gabon

events.title: CBI (Amendment) Act 2025
events.description: Amendment Act No. 22 of 2025 redefines qualifying dependants (e.g. children to 30 if supported, parents over 55).
events.quote: This Act may be cited as the Citizenship by Investment (Amendment) Act, 2025.

events.title: Built real estate option at US$500,000
events.description: SI 57 of 2026 adds approved built real estate (apartments, villas) at US$500,000 and renames marketing agents business advisory partners.

programs.name: Saint Lucia Citizenship by Investment Programme (CIP Saint Lucia)
programs.notes: Act No. 14 of 2015; regulations SI 89 of 2015 (2 Oct 2015); CIU operating from Oct 2015; first applications 1 Jan 2016. Fiscal year April-March.
